meaning.zh:
“伶牙俐齿” 或 “口才好”。

这个短语起源于爱尔兰神话，关于伯拉尼石（Blarney Stone）的传说。相传，亲吻伯拉尼石的人会获得某种特殊的能力，拥有出色的口才和说服力。因此，“the gift of the gab” 被用来形容那些善于表达、能言善辩的人。
meaning.en: This phrase originates from Irish folklore, particularly the legend of the Blarney Stone. Supposedly, anyone who kisses the Blarney Stone is granted the gift of eloquence and persuasive ability. Hence, “the gift of the gab” is used to describe people who are articulate and persuasive speakers.

lines.en: John has *the gift of the gab*; he can persuade anyone to buy anything.
lines.zh: 约翰有伶牙俐齿的本领，他能说服任何人购买任何东西。

lines.en: She certainly possesses *the gift of the gab*, making her a great salesperson.
lines.zh: 她确实拥有伶牙俐齿的口才，使她成为一名出色的销售员。

lines.en: Not everyone has *the gift of the gab*, but it can be developed with practice.
lines.zh: 并不是每个人天生都有伶牙俐齿，但通过练习可以培养这种能力。
